page_title: FRE 0-0 RBL | Freiburg v RB Leipzig 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+2' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) plants a goal-bound header towards the left post after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away. The ball goes behind for a corner. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+2' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+1' The resulting corner from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is cleared.

90+1' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
90' David Raum (RB Leipzig) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) will replace Xavi Simons.
87' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Sven Jablonski ignores the protests.
87' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Sven Jablonski saw the whole situation. That's a free kick to Freiburg.
85' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
83' The game is interrupted as Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) is flagged offside.
79' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
78' Substitution. Benjamin Sesko walks off the pitch and Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) comes on as a substitute.
78' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) replacing El Chadaille Bitshiabu.
77' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) is coming onto the pitch as Junior Adamu cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.

72' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
70' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball. Freiburg will take a free kick near the side line.
66' Dangerous play by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig). Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul. Freiburg earn a free kick.

66' The corner kick picks out El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
66' David Raum (RB Leipzig) prepares to take a corner kick.
65' RB Leipzig take a short corner kick.

65' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
64' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
64' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

64' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net, but Peter Gulacsi keeps the ball out. The linesman makes the right call and Freiburg will have a corner.
63' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

61' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
61' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ritsu Doan (Freiburg).
60' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) serves up a nice cross, but Peter Gulacsi punches the ball away.

59' What a chance that is! Christian Gunter (Freiburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
59' A cross from Lucas Holer (Freiburg) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
57' That will be all from Arthur Vermeeren who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig).
55' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Noah Atubolu intercepts the ball.

53' Close! Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
50' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.

48' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Sven Jablonski blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick has been awarded to Freiburg.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Eren Dinkci is replaced by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Marco Rose gives a chance to Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) and Kevin Kampl is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' A pass from Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is intercepted by Noah Atubolu and the move breaks down.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig) sends a long ball in, but Noah Atubolu comfortably gathers the ball.
44' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) is flagged for offside.
43' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
43' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) jumps into a tackle and Sven Jablonski signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to RB Leipzig.
41' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
38' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Lutsharel Geertruida (RB Leipzig), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
38' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
35' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
35' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
34' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Sven Jablonski who sees an offensive foul. Freiburg win a free kick.

34' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
34' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to RB Leipzig.
33' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. RB Leipzig earn a corner.
31' None of the Freiburg players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
26' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Willi Orban (RB Leipzig). Freiburg get a free kick.
26' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
25' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Sven Jablonski interrupts the game. One of the players from Freiburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. RB Leipzig will take a free kick.
23' A poorly taken free kick by Ritsu Doan (Freiburg)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall.
22' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) was too forceful with his tackle and Sven Jablonski interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Freiburg are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
22' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
21' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Noah Atubolu, who smothers the ball.
20' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
18' Rough tackle by Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. RB Leipzig have a free kick.
17' A player from Freiburg commits a rough challenge. Sven Jablonski blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. RB Leipzig are awarded the free kick.
14' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Peter Gulacsi makes a comfortable save.
13' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
12' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) sends a long ball in, but Peter Gulacsi comfortably gathers the ball.
12' RB Leipzig concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Freiburg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

10' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Noah Atubolu guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
10' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.

6' El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
6' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
1' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) on the edge of the box.
1' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. It's a free kick to RB Leipzig, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
1' The first half has started.
RB Leipzig will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Sven Jablonski.
